verdictScope: Candidate 4630bca as an executable shadow reference runtime for the Fix-Forward scope (NB-1..NB-6, SB-1..SB-5, QRE-V1CPR-02/-05/-06, D1-D7 as mapped). Not V1 authority, not a sporting, clinical or security validation.
verdictBasis: The evidence the candidate ships reproduces exactly (suite green; RED on 5ee9dec; both differentials byte-identical to the shipped files; journeys identical), and eight of the ten earlier QRE findings are closed by reproduction of their own scenarios, including QRE-V1CPR-02 in full. But the candidate introduces two BLOCKING regressions on its own new mechanisms, both reachable in ordinary flows and both dose-relevant: (1) QRE-FF-01: NB-4's missed-ladder-week rule re-opens a Situation 1 episode that a readiness restart or a declared break had superseded, so an old S1 ladder is placed over the restart's return (after a clinical hold: runs 15 -> 35 min the next day, strength 1x8 RIR4 -> 4x8 RIR3 within two weeks); 23 of 600 fuzz seeds, 0 at 5ee9dec. (2) QRE-FF-02: a marker that an extension adds to an already placed week (the CONSERVATIVE recipe's held steps; a d49 hold after a race) is never applied to that week, so a race inside a MODERATE recipe step stays at race effort, 75 minutes after 15-minute runs, with its completion item (the NB-2 / FF-Q2 (b) rule fails on that route), and a d49 hold after a race leaves 6 sets after 1 in the decision's projection. QRE-V1CPR-05 therefore stays OPEN on one route (QRE-FF-02), and QRE-V1CPR-06 stays OPEN on one survivor (M12, non-equivalent; non-blocking). Both blockers are narrow and runtime-only; for each, a fix hypothesis tried on a scratch copy removes the failure and keeps the suite at 1133/1133, so the single bounded fix cycle can address them with a narrow recheck.

fuzz.profile: Seeded random timelines on the 8-week hybrid (45% with a 10K on one of five Saturdays, 35% with known 3-6 set rows): NOT_FEELING_100 (every condition, sports, regions, intents, 1-14 days, speeds; 6% with a sign yes), WELLBEING_CHECK, RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE (travel or illness), READINESS_DECLARATION after a clinical route, MISSED_SESSION, SCHEDULE_CHANGE, PREFERENCE_CHANGE (profiles, difficulty, volume), EVENT_DATE_CHANGE, UNAVAILABLE_DAY, weekly reviews (15% skipped) with 6-8% adverse and 8-10% unreported sessions; a simple client answers check, days and screen questions. Clocks in order within a day. Invariants after each adopted step: no caught exception, determinism (30%), review JSON round trip (30%), replay of F08-bearing reviews adds no F08 row, no zero-day question, guidance on every clinical result, no race at race effort under a marker holding running or a restart's RACE_IN_RETURN, no live session inside a WAIT or R0 window, strength sets of a strength ladder week vs the week before (logged if elapsed, planned if ahead) + 1, no Situation 1 marker of a report older than the last restart or break after that restart's week, program JSON stability.

chiefObservations.classification: NON_BLOCKING for this candidate; INTEGRATION CONDITION (before integration readiness or any real-athlete use)
chiefObservations.evidence: Reproduced at the candidate and identical at 5ee9dec on seven review kinds after a sign route (W7): with the reference state every kind gives CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED; without it WEEKLY_REVIEW gives KEEP/INSTANTIATE_LOGGED_LOADS with a proposal, NOT_FEELING_100 a new window, SCHEDULE_CHANGE, PREFERENCE_CHANGE and GOAL_CHANGE re-plan, and RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE TRAVEL right after the sign gives REESTABLISH 'short nonclinical interruption'. The record holds the unreleased CLINICAL_HOLD row throughout.
chiefObservations.reasoning: Not introduced by this candidate, and it is the documented client contract (INTEGRATION_CONTRACT section 1: the client sends the last referenceState; a review that omits it loses facts, a pending clinical hold first). The narrow fix the Chief describes changes default-path outputs (the R7-D holdout models a qualified clearance by dropping the reference state: H18, H19, H24), which needs a recorded clearance form decided by Security and PCG first, so it is not a narrow runtime-only change for this round. It cannot stand as the contract for real athletes: a lost or stale reference state silently plans over a clinical hold, and a declared travel break launders it.
chiefObservations.condition: Security decides before integration readiness; QRE asks that the rule keep parity with the reference-present behaviour (every review kind but the readiness declaration holds while an unreleased record hold stands, the declared break included) and that the qualified-clearance path be recorded as a fact first. Owner: Security (decision), Engineering; PCG for the clearance form.

newFindings.title: NB-4's missed-ladder-week rule re-opens a Situation 1 episode that a readiness restart or a declared break superseded, and places its ladder over their return
newFindings.introducedBy: this candidate (missedLadderWeek in openEpisodes, episodeWeekly/episodeLadder and factualReplan); 0 occurrences at 5ee9dec
newFindings.scenario: Hybrid. Week 0 reviewed. Week 1 Tue NEED_REST REDUCE_SUBSTANTIAL 5 days; week 1 Sun review with the check, improved: ladder R2 w2, R3 w3, R4 w4. Week 2's sessions are reported on Saturday by a MISSED_SESSION review (no weekly review, no check). Week 3 Mon MINOR_DISCOMFORT with W7 yes (CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED); week 3 Wed READINESS_DECLARATION (READINESS_RESTART): week 4 holds the restart entry, runs 15/15/20, strength 1x8 RIR 4. (i) Week 3 Sun WEEKLY_REVIEW: asks the Situation 1 check ('Before this week's review...') instead of the restart check, and answered says 'the week of 2026-11-23 had no review with your check, so it counts as not done and its step repeats from next week' and places an S1 LADDER R2 marker in week 4: runs 35/35/35, then week 5 strength 4x8 RIR 3 and runs 35/35/50 (5ee9dec: week 4 15/15/20 and 1x8 RIR 4; week 5 2x8 RIR 3 and 25/25/35). (ii) A MISSED_SESSION, SCHEDULE_CHANGE or PREFERENCE_CHANGE the day after the restart restarts the S1 ladder at once: Thursday's run 15 -> 35 min, week 4 2x8 RIR 3 and 35/35/40 (5ee9dec: KEEP, unchanged). The same with a clinical declared break followed by a declaration (REESTABLISH), and after a nonclinical TRAVEL break (week 4 at R2, then week 5 straight to 4x8 RIR 3: three sets in one executed week). Fuzz: 78 steps in 23 of 600 seeds.
newFindings.cause: missedLadderWeek reads the episode's ladder weeks before the restart or break (endF08Marks never flags them: weeks before the decision are history), so openEpisodes treats the superseded episode as open; episodeWeekly then intercepts the weekly review before the restart's own check, and episodeLadder / factualReplan's NB-4 block call restartLadder, which rebuilds only the steps still on record (the later ones were removed by endF08Marks).
newFindings.expected: C-Q05-6 (a readiness restart or a declared break's return supersedes the episode, never converted), QRE-V1CP-02 / AF-01 (no S1 ladder over a restart's return), Q07 (never below MODERATE after a clinical hold), D49 (at most one set per executed week).
newFindings.smallestFix: missedLadderWeek ignores a ladder week of an episode when a readiness restart or a declared break (a REESTABLISH or READINESS_RESTART decision) is dated on or after that week's start. Tried on a scratch copy only: the four variants keep the restart's or the break's return (week 4 15/15/20 and 1x8 RIR 4; the travel variant matches 5ee9dec), the suite stays 1133/1133, and the 600-seed fuzz drops to 0 such steps with every other count unchanged. Directed tests: the variants above, RED on 4630bca.

newFindings.title: A marker that an extension adds to an already placed week is never applied to it: a race inside a MODERATE recipe step stays at race effort, and a d49 hold after a race is not applied in the projection
newFindings.introducedBy: (a) the NB-2 composition rule replaced the blocking race ASK of 5ee9dec but is not applied on this route; (b) the FF-Q2 (d) race rule in fixedStartOf drops the d49 marker's fixed start, so the week is not placed again (5ee9dec applied the d49 hold: 2/3/4 sets)
newFindings.scenario: (a) Hybrid with a 10K on 2026-12-19 (week 5 Saturday). Week 1 Mon NEED_REST REST 12 days, returnSpeed CONSERVATIVE; week 1 reviewed with its check; the return starts at the week-2 review (improved) or at a Saturday window-end check: the MODERATE recipe with each step held (M markers weeks 3-6, or 2-6). Week 5 holds LADDER M 'each' for both sports, yet the race is RACE family 75 min beside 15-min easy runs, with EVENT_AMBITIOUS_FOR_CURRENT_RUNNING in the negotiation. The same scenario with the race on 12-05, 12-12 or 12-26 gives the own event (EASY 15). Fuzz seed 395. (b) Known 6x8 rows, 10K on 12-26; week 1 Tue MINOR_DISCOMFORT REDUCE_LIGHT 4 days, CONSERVATIVE; return at the week-1 review (R3 w2, R4 w3, R4 w4); week 2 Wed EVENT_DATE_CHANGE to 12-05 (week 3): weeks 3-4 run 1 set (race week, post-race), and week 5 carries a d49 marker but plans 6 sets (5ee9dec: d49 weeks 5-7 at 2, 3, 4 sets). A later review re-places the week (2 sets) before it is reached, so the executed doses were never wrong in the sequences tried; the decision's projection is. Fuzz: d49 flags in 14 of 600 seeds, same mechanism in the seeds traced.
newFindings.cause: composeWeeks' loop (eachHold) and composeReturn's 'each' loop add week i's M marker after week i was placed and recompose only from week i+1 (week i's start is null); d49Hold's marker after a race has its FIXED start dropped by fixedStartOf's race rule, so the loop continues without placing week i again. The rung's operation and the race composition (raceAsOwnEvent, the eased race-week touch, no strength on race day) then never run on week i.
newFindings.expected: FF-Q2 (b) and its directed test ('A MODERATE recipe step in race week: an easy run, no completion prescription, no EVENT_AMBITIOUS item'); FF-Q2 (d) ('with the rung's operation still applied until the ladder completes'); D49.
newFindings.smallestFix: Whenever eachHold or d49Hold adds a marker to week i, place week i again from the state it was placed with (and in composeReturn's loop, recompose from i, not i+1). Tried on a scratch copy only: the race in week 5 becomes the own event (easy 15, at the week's easy duration, no completion item) on both routes, week 5's other doses are unchanged, the d49 week plans 2 then 3 sets as at 5ee9dec, the suite stays 1133/1133, and the 600-seed fuzz goes from 1 race-at-effort step to 0 and from 14 seeds with d49 flags to 5 (none of this mechanism; see fuzz.fixHypothesisFF02). Directed tests: (a) and (b) above, RED on 4630bca.

newFindings.title: A CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED produced by the sticky reference path carries no guidance
newFindings.scenario: A weekly review routes clinical (guidance PROFESSIONAL_ASSESSMENT); the next week's READINESS_DECLARATION, whose handler asks about unreported sessions, is turned by withReference into 'Prior clinical dependency is preserved; this reference cannot clear it' with status CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED and no guidance (fuzz seeds 131, 227, 366, clocks in order).
newFindings.cause: finish adds the default guidance from the handler's status before withReference converts a non-clinical result into the sticky clinical one.
newFindings.smallestFix: Derive the default guidance from the final status, after withReference. Note for G04/SSCTR: the sticky reminders never carry the URGENT_CARE_ADVISED level of the sign that opened the hold.
newFindings.trigger: the fix cycle or before integration

newFindings.title: NB-3's per-sport classes leave the decision's class and headline at SHORT when every sport restarts MODERATE
newFindings.scenario: QRE-V1CPR-01's scenario: interruption.class SHORT, days 7, and the reason opens 'short nonclinical interruption (7 days): resume the last completed doses; no step until execution is observed', while classBySport is MODERATE for both sports and the doses are the MODERATE entry (15/15/20, 1x8 RIR 4).
newFindings.expected: The decision's text and its class field do not contradict its prescription (a client reading interruption.class or the first clause tells the athlete the opposite).
newFindings.smallestFix: When every sport's own class is stricter, state the stricter class (or only the per-sport classes) and name classBySport as the field to read in the integration contract.

newFindings.title: I-09 counts a mid-week restart week's pre-restart (held) sessions as not done
newFindings.scenario: Clinical break (flu) reported week 3 Mon; READINESS_DECLARATION on Tue, Wed or Thu; every session from the declaration day on reported done; the week-3 review says 'your first week back was not done as planned, so it repeats once more' and holds one more entry week (weeks 4 and 5 at 15/15/20, 1x8 RIR 4).
newFindings.reading: Conservative, not a dose risk. Whether a partial restart week counts as an executed entry week is the SSCTR's (I-02 makes a partial S1 week repeat); the copy is wrong for an athlete who did every session prescribed after the restart.

newFindings.title: A program does not survive a JSON round trip: contextBefore[].noviceTemplates is undefined and the canonical hash serialises it
newFindings.scenario: Generate the hybrid program; a SCHEDULE_CHANGE (runDays [0,2,4]) gives a proposal whose contextBefore[0].noviceTemplates is undefined. The next WEEKLY_REVIEW on that proposal as kept: KEEP; on JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(proposal)): HOLD 'Program integrity or version is invalid'. Identical at 32b5ce3, 5ee9dec and 4630bca. Fuzz: 1184 adopted programs in 223 of 600 seeds are not JSON-stable.
newFindings.cause: value.mjs canonical() writes a key whose value is undefined as "key":undefined; JSON drops the key, so programHash changes after a round trip.
newFindings.reading: Not this candidate's, and outside its named blockers, but the client contract makes the client the store of the program: any JSON store breaks the next decision.

observations.note: The shipped MUTATION_FF classifies MF-M12 as NOT_SHOWN_REACHABLE; it is reachable with known rows (QF-M12). MF-D3-strength's EQUIVALENT_IN_PRACTICE agrees with 42 probes.

SB-4 reads standing from the record, so a clinical decision taken while an earlier hold row is unreleased writes no row of its own (R7-D H24 s3-s4: one row instead of two). Fail-closed, but the SB-4 test title ('always leaves its CLINICAL_HOLD fact') overstates it, and a declaration naming that later decision's id is asked ('not on record'). For Security.

For the SSCTR (D49 reading, not a regression: 5ee9dec read the planned week's maximum the same way). The count a week 'executed' is the maximum over its sessions, so a session executed before a mid-week window counts: known 6x8 rows, Monday 5 sets, MILD_ILLNESS REDUCE_SUBSTANTIAL from Wednesday (Friday 1 set at R2), FASTER return: the next week's R3 plans 5 sets after the window's 1 (fuzz seeds 207, 544).
